""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Prioritizing id attributes containing function or method keywords will increase completeness by targeting semantic HTML markers used in modern documentation generators # MECHANISM-1: Documentation tools like Sphinx and JSDoc add semantic id attributes to function definitions, which are more reliable than searching arbitrary tags # EXPECT-1: completeness > 0.40 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.1) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Filtering out signatures longer than 150 characters will improve accuracy by excluding code examples and implementation details that are not actual function signatures # MECHANISM-2: Real function signatures are concise, while code blocks and examples tend to be verbose, creating false positives # EXPECT-2: accuracy > 0.85 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.2222222222222222) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions_dict = {} # Use dict to deduplicate by name # Strategy 1: Look for elements with semantic id attributes for elem in soup.find_all(id=True): elem_id = elem.get('id', '').lower() if any(keyword in elem_id for keyword in ['function', 'method', 'api', 'def-', 'fn-']): text = elem.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) <= 150: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name.isidentifier(): desc = "No description found" # Look for description in next sibling or parent's next sibling next_elem = elem.find_next_sibling() if next_elem: desc = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:500] functions_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # Strategy 2: Look for dt/dd pairs (common in Python/Sphinx docs) for dt in soup.find_all("dt"): text = dt.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) <= 150: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name.isidentifier() and name not in functions_dict: desc = "No description found" dd = dt.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: desc = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:500] functions_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # Strategy 3: Look for semantic class names for cls in ["function", "method", "api-item", "api-entry"]: for block in soup.find_all(class_=cls): # Find code or signature within the block code_tag = block.find(["code", "pre", "span"], class_=lambda x: x and "sig" in x.lower()) if not code_tag: code_tag = block.find(["code", "pre"]) if code_tag: text = code_tag.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) <= 150: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name.isidentifier() and name not in functions_dict: desc = "No description found" p_tag = block.find("p") if p_tag: desc = p_tag.get_text(strip=True)[:500] functions_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(functions_dict.values()) def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Split on comma but handle nested structures param_parts = re.split(r',(?![^(]*\))', param_string) for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ['...', '*', '**']: # Extract name, handling type annotations and defaults name = part.split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() name = name.lstrip('*').strip() if name and name.isidentifier(): params.append({ "name": name, "type": "unknown", "default": None, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
